fullDescription: LiquidUI is a production-grade dark neumorphic design system specifically engineered for high-impact SaaS and fintech interfaces. It features an 'aggressive' tactile aesthetic using deep shadows and soft highlights to create a sense of physical depth. The palette is a sophisticated mix of deep navy (#151A28) and slate (#1F2A3A) with high-contrast amber (#F59E0B) and teal (#38B2AC) accents. Key characteristics include heavy border-radius (32px), bento-grid layouts, and micro-interactions that simulate physical buttons clicking into the surface. Ideal for complex data dashboards, technical specifications, and command centers.
prompt:
## Resumo
A dark-mode neumorphic design system utilizing dual-tone shadows (light/dark) to create extruded and inset surfaces, paired with high-performance typography and vibrant accent colors for technical SaaS applications.

## Estilo Visual
Create a dark neumorphic UI with a background of #151A28 and surface cards of #1F2A3A. Implement two distinct shadow types: 1. Extruded: '8px 8px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)' and '-8px -8px 12px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12)'. 2. Inset: 'inset 6px 6px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)' and 'inset -6px -6px 8px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12)'. Borders should be '1px solid rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.25)'. Typography: Headings in Plus Jakarta Sans (ExtraBold), Body in DM Sans, and technical data in JetBrains Mono. Use #F59E0B for brand accents and #38B2AC for secondary data. Buttons must shift from extruded to inset on :active state with a 2px vertical translate.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Header
Large branding area with title in font-size 48px, weight 800 (Plus Jakarta Sans). Include a distinct colored period/dot at the end. Right-aligned navigation should feature square 48x48px buttons with 16px border-radius and extruded neumorphic shadows.

### Action Components & Tabs
Two-column section. Left: Primary CTA buttons with 16px padding and 20px border-radius. Search bar with inset shadow and left-aligned icon. Right: Segmented tab navigation where the container is inset and the active tab is extruded with an accent background.

### Form Controls
A dedicated grid for technical inputs. Include labels in uppercase, 10px font-size, tracking-widest. Inputs should be inset rectangles with 16px border-radius. Group controls like counter buttons (minus/plus) alongside an inset value display.

### Bento Module Catalog
Three-column grid of cards. Cards feature 32px border-radius, extruded shadows, and #1F2A3A background. Each card contains a 48px square inset icon container, a bold title, and a footer with a technical version string in JetBrains Mono and a hover-triggered arrow animation.

### Operational Data Grid
Full-width table housed within an extruded 32px radius container. Header row should be 50% opacity background. Cells feature mono-font IDs and status badges (low-opacity backgrounds with high-opacity text). Footer includes pagination using a mix of inset and extruded square buttons.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Neumorphic Selection Controls — Custom checkboxes and radios that look like physical switches.
Checkbox: 24x24px, 6px radius, inset shadow background. When checked, background fills with #F59E0B and shows a white checkmark. Radio: 24x24px, 50% radius, inset shadow. When checked, displays a 10px solid #F59E0B center dot. Toggle: 48x24px pill shape with inset shadow, featuring a sliding circular knob that moves 24px and changes color when active.

### File Drop Zone — Interactive dashed upload area.
2px dashed border using rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.25). Inset background #151A28. Hover state should change border to #F59E0B and add a subtle 5% opacity tint to the background. 32px border-radius.

### Tactile Modal — High-focus overlay with extreme blur.
Backdrop: rgba(10, 12, 18, 0.85) with 8px backdrop-filter blur. Modal: 32px border-radius, background #1F2A3A, heavy extruded shadow. Footer buttons must span equal widths with one primary extruded action and one secondary inset action.

## Notas Especiais
MUST maintain the specific dual-shadow values to achieve the neumorphic effect; single shadows will break the style. MUST NOT use pure black or pure white for backgrounds. MUST use JetBrains Mono for all numeric or path-based data. MUST ensure all interactive elements have a visible 'inset' state change on click/active.

style.description: The style is defined by its 'Tactile Dark' aesthetic. It uses DM Sans for readability, Plus Jakarta Sans for high-energy headings, and JetBrains Mono for data. Surfaces are never flat; they are either 'extruded' (raised) or 'inset' (depressed). Color is used sparingly but purposefully: Amber (#F59E0B) for primary actions and Teal (#38B2AC) for success states or versioning. Transitions use a sharp cubic-bezier (0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) to feel responsive and mechanical.
